manifest.purpose: Frozen paired simulated-layout comparison and separate artificial opening stress test

settings.score: mean predicted cube distance to carry/placement reference, metres
settings.carry_reference: initial cube-hand offset plus nominal predicted hand position
settings.placement_reference: initial cube xy and bin height plus 20 mm cube half-size
settings.execution: execute only first chosen gripper request; observe and compare again
settings.placement_open_gate: Keep BC when the cube is in the bin, low, and the applied gripper command is open

manifest.stress_rule: One opening request after cube z >= 70 mm, outside bin xy tolerance, with applied and requested gripper closed; subsequent BC requests resume.
